context: Tests whether the agent builds the right icalpal query. icalpal only runs on macOS, so the agent records the command it would run and the rubric grades that command. Reads the remaining events and limits properties to times and titles.

checklist.name: Limits properties
checklist.description: The command uses `--iep` with title and start_date, and optionally end_date, and does not include other properties such as location, attendees or notes.

checklist.name: Does not use all properties
checklist.description: The command does not use `--iep=all` or `--aep`.
